title: Strict henselian local rings in the etale contraction
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $R^{\mathrm e}$ be its etale contraction [def-weil-pbc-etale-contraction]. The map $R\to R^{\mathrm e}$ is faithfully flat and ind-etale
[def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-algebra]. Every faithfully flat etale algebra of
finite presentation over $R^{\mathrm e}$ has a section. Every maximal
localization of $R^{\mathrm e}$ is strictly henselian
[def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology].

proof.text: For a multiplicative base-change-stable property Q containing the chosen étale faithfully-flat factors, present the custom step map as a pro-Q morphism: use its finite-family diagram followed by Over.forget, the limiting cone, and MorphismProperty.widePullbackBase for every finite tensor. The empty finite family gives nonemptiness of the index and includes the empty tensor. This is the private helper step_pro, proved directly from the construction and the existing generic wide-pullback theorem.

proof.text: For any multiplicative Q with pro Q = Q, the sequential limiting projections satisfy Q: all transition maps do by multiplicativity, pro_coneπ gives the pro-property of the limit projections, and the countable index lifts to the ambient universe. For faithful flatness use the source library theorem CommRingCat.ind_faithfullyFlat_eq_faithfullyFlat, dualized to pro. For ind-étaleness use Q = pro(etale.op), its generic multiplicativity and pro-idempotence from finite presentation, and RingHom.IndEtale.iff_ind_etale. Thus every stage-to-contraction map has both properties. These are the helpers projection_prop, projection_faithfullyFlat, projection_indEtale.

proof.text: For any chosen faithfully-flat étale algebra over a stage, take its SmallModel image and then its Skeleton class. The singleton finite family containing that class gives a limit projection to its tensor factor. Compose with the Skeleton and SmallModel comparison isomorphisms in the over-category. This produces a next-stage map to the original object, with its structure-map equation; this is step_factor.

proof.text: Apply the source library étale PreIndSpreads instance, dually PreProSpreads and lowered to the countable index universe, to the custom sequential limiting cone. It descends any étale map into that limit to an étale map u at a stage and a pullback square. The composite v followed by u is faithfully flat because the original cover and the limiting projection are. Therefore u is surjective on spectra, by surjectivity of the composite, and is flat because it is étale. Apply step_factor to u and the pullback universal property to construct a retraction of the original map; the limit-cone equation at n to n+1 supplies the compatibility. This is contraction_retraction. Taking underlying ring homomorphisms gives ring_retraction. This uses direct algebraic descent, rather than descending a scheme and separately proving it eventually affine.

proof.text: Assemble the initial-map faithful-flat and ind-étale conclusions. For an algebra B over the contraction, its faithful flatness implies spectrum surjectivity; apply ring_retraction and use the retraction identity as the commutes field of the algebra homomorphism B to the contraction. Finally apply the existing generic maximal-localization criterion to ring_retraction. The finite-presentation hypothesis is retained verbatim; the algebraic étale descent theorem already applies without needing to use it separately.
